name: Mérida
registryBasis: The Ayuntamiento de Mérida identifies a Dirección de Catastro Municipal, and its official Geoportal describes municipal cadastral information covering Mérida and its comisarías. The portal’s public guide describes searching and locating individual properties; no parcel-specific search or selection was used. The municipality and registry are city-bound, but no safe geometry-only response was verified.

La guía del portal ofrece búsquedas/localización de predios, sin exponer un esquema de geometría solamente. El acceso directo al mapa mostró una página de protección anti-bot/403; no se resolvió ni se envió formulario.

officialSources.observation: Official Ayuntamiento directory identifies the Dirección de Catastro Municipal.

Official municipal Geoportal describes its spatial platform and municipal cadastral information including comisarías; its public guide describes property searches. The direct landing GET returned a Radware challenge page (HTTP 200), while the public web inspection returned 403; no challenge was solved or parcel searched.
Official municipal service catalogue includes cadastral procedures; no application, cadastral key, address or payment was submitted.
